Overview — What is a GeoTrust SSL certificate?

A GeoTrust SSL/TLS certificate encrypts the connection between your website and your visitors, so passwords, payments and personal data can't be intercepted. GeoTrust — part of the DigiCert family of certificate authorities — is trusted by 99.9% of browsers and mobile devices, and shows the padlock (and, for EV, your verified business name) that customers look for before they buy.

XcellHost is an authorised GeoTrust partner in India. We handle CSR generation, validation, issuance, installation and lifecycle renewal for you — with a GST invoice on every order and 24×7 support from our Mumbai NOC.

Frequently asked questions

It's a digital certificate from the GeoTrust certificate authority (part of DigiCert) that encrypts traffic between your website and its visitors and verifies your site's identity. It shows the padlock in browsers and — for EV — your verified business name.

Yes. XcellHost is an authorised GeoTrust / DigiCert partner and has delivered SSL and cloud security to Indian businesses since 1999. Every order includes a GST invoice and 24×7 support from our Mumbai NOC.

DV validates domain ownership only and issues in minutes. OV also verifies your organization and shows business details in the certificate. EV is the highest assurance with rigorous vetting and the largest warranties — ideal for e-commerce and banking.

DV certificates are typically issued within minutes of validation. OV takes 1–3 business days and EV 1–5 business days, depending on how quickly business verification documents are provided.

Yes — free managed installation is included. Our engineers generate the CSR, complete validation and install the certificate on your web server or load balancer, and can automate future renewals.

A SAN (multi-domain) certificate secures several different domains under one certificate — add them in the configurator. A wildcard secures unlimited subdomains of a single domain (e.g. *.yourbusiness.com).

Yes. Every purchase includes a compliant GST invoice. You can pay online via UPI, credit/debit cards or NetBanking, and we're happy to share exact pricing and multi-year discounts.

With XcellHost SSL automation, we monitor expiry and auto-renew and redeploy before the certificate lapses. Without automation, we send renewal reminders and can handle the renewal and re-installation for you.
